title: Addressing the Evidence agent
description: How to write for a reader acting as Evidence agent. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `evidence-agent` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Appraising
rules.description: Appraising. State the question, the sources searched, what was found and what was discarded with the reason.

source.quote: Searches trusted sources and appraises what comes back. Its value is in what it REJECTS, so it must be able to say why a source was not used.
